quotes.text: The default notification test must still open `chrome://calendar/content/calendar-summary-dialog.xhtml` with `calendar.dialogs.new.enabled` false/default. For the new-dialog notification test, use the stored result of `await calendar.addItem(event)` and assert center against `#tabpanelcontainer` within 1px. Final focused validation passed lint, `git diff --check`, five browser tests (216 checks), and `test_dialog_position.js` (83 checks). [Task 1]
